token.heading: Set up Coaming
token.body: Enter the setup token printed in the container logs when Coaming started.
token.label: Setup token

admin.heading: Create the admin account
admin.body: This account can manage everything in this Coaming instance.

username.label: Username
username.helper: 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Not case-sensitive.

password.label: Password
password.helper: At least 12 characters. A long passphrase works well.

instance.heading: Name this instance
instance.body: You can change both of these later in Settings.

name.label: Instance name
name.helper: Shown in the header, the browser tab and the sign-in page.

url.label: Public URL
url.helper: The address people use to reach Coaming. It controls cookies and request origin checks.
url.locked: Set by the COAMING_PUBLIC_URL environment variable.

errors.tokenInvalid: That setup token isn't valid. Copy it again from the container logs.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.username: Use 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.passwordCommon: That password is too common. Choose something harder to guess.
errors.publicUrl: Enter a full address such as https://coaming.example.com.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the container logs if it keeps happening.

restore.heading: Restore from a backup
restore.body: Upload a backup file and enter its passphrase. Coaming checks it before changing anything.
